# Public-effect first-source study

Informed sources and policy/current predictions are fixed before source checking. The compiler presently exposes principal effects behind pub; this study is not a blind authoring benchmark. All projects contain at most one live physical qubit. Existing std::quantum and std::observe paths are used deliberately before their separate cutover. No access spelling is changed; any future access extension must use ctrl/excl.

The same-module precision case selects a proposed explicit internal rule; #355 permits such precision but its external contract is always Observe. False pure labels remain forbidden for direct and transitive measure/reset/discard. Public ordinary classical inference remains distinct from quantum-processing annotation requirements.

Original source trees and first-sources.json are immutable. Fresh observation commands will be stored separately. Initial command discovery attempted `qleisli check --help`, which returned usage exit 2 before any source check; it is not a source diagnostic or acceptance result.
